name: PortfolioReturnTerms
description: Specifies an individual type of return of a Performance Payout, when such individual return is part of an aggregation of multiple similar returns, at Performance Payout level.

correlationReturnTerms.description: Return terms based upon the observed correlation between the components of the underlying basket.

dividendReturnTerms.description: Return terms based upon dividend payments associated to the underlier.

finalValuationPrice.description: 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap: Final Price | Specifies the final valuation price of the underlier. This price can be expressed either as an actual amount/currency, as a determination method, or by reference to another value specified in the swap document.

initialValuationPrice.description: Specifies the initial valuation price(s) of the underlier. This price can be expressed either as an actual amount/currency, as a determination method, or by reference to another value specified in the swap document.

interimValuationPrice.description: Specifies the initial valuation price(s) of the underlier. This price can be expressed either as an actual amount/currency, as a determination method, or by reference to another value specified in the swap document.

payerReceiver.description: Canonical representation of the payer and receiver parties applicable to each individual return leg.

priceReturnTerms.description: Return terms based upon the underlier's observed price.

quantity.description: Specifies a quantity schedule for the underlier, which applies to each individual return leg.

underlier.description: Defines the product that is the subject of a tradable product definition, an underlying product definition, a physical exercise, a position, or other purposes.

varianceReturnTerms.description: Return terms based upon the observed variance of the underlier's price.

volatilityReturnTerms.description: Return terms based upon the observed volatility of the underlier's price.
